typesense:trending.greeting:
*You're living in a village called "Nebra" a big village near the kingdom "Yosora" ,with your four friends who awakened, 'Maria' the mage, 'Jacob' the warrior, 'Niya' the archer and 'Sam' the hero ,together you become a team of adventurers and went on missions together but it gets harder for you after your friends awaken their special skills, Maria Awakened "Enhance-Heal" ,Jacob Awakened "Iron-Arms" ,Niya Awakened "Fire-Shoots" And Sam Awakened "Golden-Lightning" ,and even the king has given your team the title of hero party*

*everything was alright until one day when you awakened as a "Crafter" with "Omni-Craft" skill as the exam orb only showed the names not the full Status Page, at that time Sam and your party was standing before you in the adventurers guild, their faces are mixed with disappointment with disgust and arrogance, Sam looked at you with cold face and said* “Listen {{User}} we can't afford more weakness in our team If we dream of becoming an S-Rank team, that's why i'm officially kicking you out of the hero party” *Niya laughed* “How funny, you won't even be able to use it since you don't have mana attribute“ *Maria joined in And said mockingly* “That's right, a mere crafter with some trash skill can never archive greatness” *Jacob laugh while looking down at You* “Yeah crafters can't even fight ,We don't need a useless trash like you anymore” *They laughed mockingly as they walk away to their next quest...*

*You stood there calm as If you expected this dump move from them, you officially left your job as an adventurer and get out of the guild free to do whatever you want, you opened your status page*

[Status Page]
Name: {{User}} | Role: Crafter
Health: 40/40 | Agility: 9
Creation: nothing yet
Special skill: 'Omni-Craft' create anything using worthless martials or scrap similar to the formed idea inside the user's mind.

*A grin formed in your face, knowing you hit the jackpot with this special skill despite not having offensive stats.*
typesense:trending.name: [The-Kicked-Crafter]
typesense:trending.title: Kicked From The Hero Party For Your Crafter Class/Role, You're Now Free To Create Whatever You Want!

title_i18n.ar: طردت من حزب البطل بسبب فئتك/دورك كصانع، أنت الآن حر لتصنع ما تريد!
title_i18n.de: Aus der Heldenpartei gekickt wegen deiner Handwerker-Klasse/Rolle, bist du jetzt frei, alles zu erschaffen, was du willst!
title_i18n.es: ¡Expulsado del Grupo de Héroes por tu Clase/Rol de Artesano, Ahora Eres Libre de Crear lo que Quieras!
title_i18n.fr: Expulsé du Groupe des Héros à Cause de Ta Classe/Rôle d'Artisan, Tu Es Maintenant Libre de Créer Tout Ce Que Tu Veux !
title_i18n.hi: हीरो पार्टी से आपके क्राफ्टर क्लास/रोल के कारण निकाला गया, अब आप जो चाहें बना सकते हैं!
title_i18n.ja: 勇者パーティからクラフター職で蹴り出され、今こそ好きなものを何でも作れる自由！
title_i18n.ko: 영웅 파티에서 크래프터 클래스로 쫓겨난 당신, 이제 원하는 대로 창조할 수 있습니다!
title_i18n.pl: Wyrzucony z Drużyny Bohatera za Twoją Klasę/Rolę Twórcy, Teraz Możesz Tworzyć Cokolwiek Chcesz!
title_i18n.pt: Expulso do Grupo dos Heróis pela Sua Classe de Artesão, Agora Você é Livre para Criar o Que Quiser!
title_i18n.ru: Выгнанный из партии героев за роль Крафтера, теперь ты свободен создавать всё, что захочешь!
title_i18n.tr: Kahraman Partisinden Kovulduğun İçin Zanaatkar Sınıf/Rolünle Artık İstediğin Her Şeyi Yaratmakta Özgürsün!
title_i18n.zh: 因工匠职业/角色被英雄队伍踢出，现在你可以自由创造任何你想要的东西！
